phase: Full waveform reference-pair encoding GP v1
input: Full3x128 current V/I/time window, physical channel scaling and optional difference from mean first10 waveform. No cycle-age features or query labels.
source_fit: Exact original source_keys; raw scaler, resolved-column pruning, PCA8/PLS4 and GP fit only those rows. Discard latent source std<=1e-6 to avoid numerical nullspace amplification.
selection: Full B12 original validation domain-equal MAE; same chosen branch/weight across four ablation parents
controls: Separately validation-selected absolute versus paired, PCA versus PLS families
limits: Ordinary PCA/PLS is not itself claimed novel
Reference capacity and first10 labels are allowed support information
No CALCE tuning; original model artifacts immutable
